ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-agent academic and mental health peer support platform tailored for high school student stress management.
ideas.title: StudyPulse PHS
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the multi-agent student support architecture that won 1st place at the GreenNovation Hackathon, directly targeting high school student wellness needs which resonate heavily with local judges.

ideas.pitch: Satellite and local data monitoring dashboard tracking environmental compliance and green spaces in Princeton.
ideas.title: LocalEco Monitor PHS
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs heavy GIS data processing similar to the runner-up GeoNex-ATLAS project, showcasing complex technical execution that stands out to technical judges.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI-driven triage and resource booking engine for local youth counseling and health services.
ideas.title: CampusCare AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the rapid patient acquisition and trust engine pattern from the Elevate X win, focusing on a polished user-facing workflow within a tight timeframe.

ideas.pitch: A predictive forecasting dashboard modeling local transit delays and commuter bottlenecks using statistical regression models.
ideas.title: Princeton Transit Optimiser
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages rigorous forecasting and Poisson regression methodologies proven successful at the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: Personalized cafeteria and local meal recommendation platform optimizing for teenage nutritional health and dietary restrictions.
ideas.title: LocalBites AI Nutrition
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the exact scope and consumer utility of the Hour Hackathon winning E-Foodiee platform, guaranteeing a high demo-day appeal.
